full_judgment: 8. Appearing on behalf of the petitioner the learned Counsel Md. Fazlul Karim first contends that the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the learned Judges of the High Court Division did not advert to the reasoning and observations of the trial court nor did they reverse all the material findings of the said court. But he fails to substantiate his point.
